description: Converts a local departure time and a journey time into the local arrival date and time at the destination, using IANA time-zone rules (including daylight saving on the exact dates). Alternatively, pass the local arrival time to get the journey time. Returns the time difference when landing (which can exceed 12 hours across the date line), the calendar-day change as airlines show it (+1, +2, −1), a plain-English explanation and any clock-change notes. Does not look up flights or schedules. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/flight-arrival-time-calculator

arrival.description: Optional: arrival, local time at the destination, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. If given, the journey time is worked out from it.

arrivalTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the arrival airport, e.g. Pacific/Honolulu.

departure.description: Departure, local time at the departure airport, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM.

departureTimeZone.description: IANA time zone of the departure airport, e.g. Pacific/Auckland.

flightHours.description: Journey time, whole hours (use with flightMinutes). Ignored if arrival is given.

name: flight-arrival-time-calculator
title: Flight arrival time calculator
